📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough Adds a helper `isMultipartUploadsPath` in `EmptyFolderCleaner` to detect S3 multipart upload staging paths (`/.uploads`), and inserts early-return guards in `OnDeleteEvent` and `executeCleanup` so those staging directories are excluded from queueing and deletion. Includes new unit tests covering the helper and both guarded code paths. ### Changes **Multipart staging path exclusion** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Multipart staging path detection helper**
`weed/filer/empty_folder_cleanup/empty_folder_cleaner.go`, `weed/filer/empty_folder_cleanup/empty_folder_cleaner_test.go`|Adds `isMultipartUploadsPath(bucketPath, directory string) bool`, checking whether a directory's first segment beneath the bucket path matches the multipart uploads staging folder name; adds table-driven tests covering staging root, nested hashstates, normal folders, `_uploads` registry paths, bucket root, and empty bucketPath cases.| |**Guard cleanup queueing and execution**
`weed/filer/empty_folder_cleanup/empty_folder_cleaner.go`, `weed/filer/empty_folder_cleanup/empty_folder_cleaner_test.go`|`OnDeleteEvent` and `executeCleanup` gain early returns to skip multipart staging directories; adds tests confirming staging paths are skipped in both delete-event queueing and cleanup execution while normal folder deletes still proceed.| **Estimated code review effort:** 2 (Simple) | ~10 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Filer participant EmptyFolderCleaner participant isMultipartUploadsPath participant FilerOps Filer->>EmptyFolderCleaner: OnDeleteEvent(directory) EmptyFolderCleaner->>isMultipartUploadsPath: check(bucketPath, directory) isMultipartUploadsPath-->>EmptyFolderCleaner: true (staging path) EmptyFolderCleaner-->>Filer: skip queueing Filer->>EmptyFolderCleaner: OnDeleteEvent(normalFolder) EmptyFolderCleaner->>isMultipartUploadsPath: check(bucketPath, normalFolder) isMultipartUploadsPath-->>EmptyFolderCleaner: false EmptyFolderCleaner->>EmptyFolderCleaner: enqueue cleanup EmptyFolderCleaner->>isMultipartUploadsPath: executeCleanup check(directory) isMultipartUploadsPath-->>EmptyFolderCleaner: false EmptyFolderCleaner->>FilerOps: delete(normalFolder) ``` **Possibly related PRs** - [seaweedfs/seaweedfs#7614](https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/7614): Both PRs modify `EmptyFolderCleaner`'s delete/cleanup path handling, with this PR extending the async cleanup flow introduced there by adding early returns to skip the multipart staging tree.

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
